roots.origin: 拉丁语 jungere（把两物套到一处），过去分词 junctus；jugum（牛轭）同根——两头牛套进同一副轭，是这一族的本象
roots.core_concept: two things set into one yoke so they move as one / 两物套进同一副轭，从此一起动
roots.core_image: 一副木轭卡在两头牛的颈上，一头往前，另一头跟着走

roots.origin: 拉丁语 jus（属格 juris：法、权利）；judex 是 jus＋dicere（宣法者），jurare 是「按法起誓」，justus 是「合于法的」
roots.core_concept: the standard by which right is measured / 衡量对错所依的那把准
roots.core_image: 一杆秤立在中间，两边各放一份，看它往哪边偏

roots.origin: 拉丁语 ire（去、行走），过去分词 itum；exire（出去）、initium（进入之始）、exitus（出口）皆由此出
roots.core_concept: setting off and passing through / 起脚往前，一路走过去
roots.core_image: 门槛一跨，脚已经落在门外那一侧

roots.origin: 拉丁语 haerere（黏住、卡住不动），过去分词 haesus；黏得牢即「连贯」，卡住不动即「犹疑」，两支同出一象
roots.core_concept: sticking fast so it will not come loose / 黏牢在那儿，撕不开也动不了
roots.core_image: 两张纸沾在一处，手一撕就带下毛边，谁也不肯干净分开

roots.origin: 拉丁语 -fendere（击、挡），只见于复合词：defendere（挡开）、offendere（撞上去）；英语 fence 是 defence 的截短
roots.core_concept: striking to keep a thing off / 挥出去一击，把来的挡在外头
roots.core_image: 手臂横着一挡，来的那一下被架在外圈

roots.origin: 拉丁语 frons（属格 frontis：额头、正面）；额头是人朝前的那一面，故引申为凡物的正面与前缘
roots.core_concept: the face a thing turns forward / 一物朝前的那一面
roots.core_image: 两人对面站着，额头正对额头，谁也没侧过身

roots.origin: 拉丁语 vadere（迈开步子走、涉水而过），过去分词 vasus；invadere 是「迈进别人的地界」，evadere 是「迈出去脱身」
roots.core_concept: striding across a line one is not meant to cross / 大步迈过那条本不该跨的线
roots.core_image: 一脚跨过界桩，另一只脚跟着落在别人的地里

roots.origin: 拉丁语 fari（说、开口），现在分词 fans、过去分词中性 fatum。第六十一批先建的 fatum（说定之数）正是它的过去分词；本根是被派生的本体，二者同源分支不同，照 dare 与 edere-publish/tradere 的先例并立
roots.core_concept: opening the mouth and letting words out / 开口，把话放出来
roots.core_image: 嘴唇一动，话就出去了，收不回来

roots.origin: 拉丁语 flos（属格 floris：花）；开到最盛即 flourish，而 flour 本是「面粉中最好的那一层」（fleur de farine），故也归此支
roots.core_concept: the best of a thing, come to full bloom / 一物最盛、最好的那一层
roots.core_image: 枝头那一朵开到最满，花瓣再展就要落了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 heres（属格 heredis：继承人）；hereditare 是「接过来」，英语 heir 经古法语 eir 入，h 是后来照拉丁语补写的
roots.core_concept: the one whose hands the thing passes into next / 东西下一步落到谁手里
roots.core_image: 老人把那串钥匙放到一个人手心，自己的手就松开了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 jocus（玩笑、戏言）；古法语 jouel（小玩物）派出 jewel 一支——本指供人玩赏的小物，后专指宝石
roots.core_concept: a small thing made for delight, not use / 拿来逗趣玩赏、不为实用的小东西
roots.core_image: 掌心里那个小玩意儿被翻来翻去，逗得旁人都笑了

roots.origin: 希腊语 dran（做、行动）；drama 本指「做出来给人看的一场」，drastikos 指「见效猛的」——同一个「做」字，一支往台上走，一支往力道走
roots.core_concept: something done in full view, with effect / 摆开来做给人看，且见得着效
roots.core_image: 台上那人一举手，底下几百双眼跟着动

words.root_logic: jungere（套到一处）→ 把两边接上，或自己并进去
words.origin: 古法语 joindre ← 拉丁语 jungere（接合）
words.native_definition: to connect two things; to become a member of a group
words.core_concept: bringing two ends together until they hold as one – 把两头凑到一处，直到它们成一体
words.core_image: 两截管子对上口，箍一紧就再拔不开
examples: She joined the club last spring.
semantic_expansions: 连接/接合：把两头凑到一处使成一体
加入：把自己并进那一群里
words.recall_hint: jungere（套到一处）→ 把两边接上

words.root_logic: junctus（已接合的）→ 两段相接的那一处 → 关节、接头
words.origin: 古法语 jointe ← 拉丁语 junctus（jungere 的过去分词）
words.native_definition: a place where two parts meet and can move; shared between two
words.core_concept: the spot where two pieces meet and still bend – 两段相接、又还能弯的那一处
words.core_image: 两根骨头搭在一处，中间那点能屈能伸
semantic_expansions: 关节/接头：两段相接又能活动的那一处
共同的：两方套在同一副轭里、一起承担
words.recall_hint: junctus（已接合）→ 两段相接的那一处

words.root_logic: junct（接合）+ -ion → 几条道接到一处的那个点 → 交汇处
words.origin: 拉丁语 junctio（接合）← jungere（接合）
words.native_definition: a place where roads or railway lines meet
words.core_concept: the point several ways run into and become one – 几条路跑到一处、并成一条的那个点
words.core_image: 三条道跑到一处并成一条，中间立着一根杆
examples: Turn left at the next junction.
The junction was closed for repairs.
semantic_expansions: 交汇处/路口：几条道接到一处的那个点
枢纽：多条线路在此并接的要地
words.recall_hint: junct（接合）+ -ion → 几条道接到一处的点

words.root_logic: jus（法）+ dicere（说）→ judex（宣法的人）→ 依准断定
words.origin: 古法语 juger ← 拉丁语 judicare ← judex（法官）← jus（法）＋dicere（说）
words.native_definition: to form an opinion after weighing evidence; a person who decides in court
words.core_concept: the one who reads the scale and says which way it went – 看着秤，说出它偏向哪边的那个
words.core_image: 两边的说法都听完，他抬头说出偏向哪一边
semantic_expansions: 判断/评判：依准衡量后说出结论
法官：受命做此事的那个人
words.recall_hint: jus（法）+ dicere（说）→ 依准断定的人

words.root_logic: jurare（按法起誓）→ 起过誓来断案的那一组人
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 juree ← 拉丁语 jurata（起誓者）← jurare（起誓）← jus（法）
words.native_definition: a group of people who decide a verdict in court
words.core_concept: the several sworn in to read the scale together – 一齐起过誓、共同看秤的那几个人
words.core_image: 十二个人挨着坐一排，手按在书上说完同一句话
examples: She served on a jury last year.
semantic_expansions: 陪审团/评审团：起誓后共同评断的那一组人
words.recall_hint: jurare（按法起誓）→ 起誓断案的那组人

words.root_logic: just（合于法）+ -ice → 该给谁的就给谁 → 公正
words.origin: 古法语 justice ← 拉丁语 justitia（公正）← justus（合法的）← jus（法）
words.native_definition: fair treatment; the system of law
words.core_concept: the scale coming to rest level, neither side favoured – 秤停在正中，两边谁也不占便宜
words.core_image: 两份东西各放一边，指针不偏不倚停在中线
examples: The case went to the justice system.
semantic_expansions: 公正/正义：秤停在正中、该给谁给谁
司法：把这套准则落实下来的那一整套
words.recall_hint: just（合于法）+ -ice → 该给谁就给谁

words.root_logic: just（合于法）+ -ify（使…）→ 说明它站得住 → 证明正当
words.origin: 古法语 justifier ← 晚期拉丁语 justificare ← justus（合法的）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to show that something is right or reasonable
words.core_concept: putting weight on your side until the scale tips your way – 往自己这边添分量，直到秤偏过来
words.core_image: 他把一件件依据摆到自己那盘里，秤慢慢压了过去
semantic_expansions: 证明正当/为…提供理由：添够分量使秤偏向自己
辩解：为已做之事补上这份分量
words.recall_hint: just（合于法）+ -ify → 说明它站得住

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ it（ire 行走）→ 走出去的那个口
words.origin: 拉丁语 exitus（出去、出口）← exire（出去）← ex＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: a way out of a place; the act of leaving
words.core_concept: the gap you step through on the way out – 往外走时跨过的那个口
words.core_image: 绿灯亮着的那扇门后头是台阶，人一个个跨出去
examples: The exit is at the back.
semantic_expansions: 出口：往外走时跨过的那个口
退场/离开：跨出去这个动作本身
words.recall_hint: ex-（出）+ it（行走）→ 走出去的那个口

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ it（行走）+ -al → initium（迈进的第一步）→ 最初的
words.origin: 拉丁语 initialis（起头的）← initium（开始）← inire（进入）← in＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: existing at the beginning; the first letter of a name
words.core_concept: the first foot set down inside the door – 进门后落下的第一只脚
words.core_image: 刚跨进来那一步印在灰上，后面的脚印都在它前头
semantic_expansions: 最初的/开头的：进门后落下的第一只脚
首字母：名字最前头那一个字
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ it（行走）→ 迈进的第一步

words.root_logic: initium（第一步）+ -ate（使…）→ 走出第一步 → 发起
words.origin: 拉丁语 initiare（开始、引入）← initium ← inire（进入）← in＋ire
words.native_definition: to cause something to begin; to admit someone into a group
words.core_concept: taking the one step that starts the rest moving – 迈出那一步，后面的才跟着动
words.core_image: 他先走了一步，原地站着的人这才跟上
examples: He was initiated into the order.
semantic_expansions: 发起/开始：迈出那第一步使其余跟着动
使入会：引某人跨进那个圈子
words.recall_hint: initium（第一步）+ -ate → 走出第一步

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ issue（ire 行走）→ 走出来的那一批 → 发行；引申为待处理之事
words.origin: 古法语 issue（出去、结果）← 拉丁语 exire（出去）← ex＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: an important topic; a set of copies published at one time; to send out
words.core_concept: what comes walking out of the door, batch by batch – 一批批从门里走出来的那些
words.core_image: 印好的一摞从后门一批批运出来，封面日期都一样
semantic_expansions: 问题/议题：摆到面前待处理的那一桩
期号/发行：一批批出门的那些印本
words.recall_hint: ex-（出）+ issue（行走）→ 走出来的那一批

words.root_logic: co-（一起）+ her（黏住）+ -ent → 各部分黏成一体、说得通的
words.origin: 拉丁语 cohaerens（连在一起的）← cohaerere ← com＋haerere（黏住）
words.native_definition: logically connected and easy to follow
words.core_concept: the parts stuck together so tightly the whole holds – 各部分黏得够牢，整体拎起来不散
words.core_image: 几段话前后咬着，抽掉哪一段后面都接不上
semantic_expansions: 连贯的/条理清楚的：各部分黏成一体、拎起来不散
words.recall_hint: co-（一起）+ her（黏住）→ 各部分黏成一体

words.root_logic: co-（一起）+ hes（黏住）+ -ive → 能把彼此黏住的
words.origin: 英语 cohesive，来自拉丁语 cohaesus（cohaerere 的过去分词）← haerere
words.native_definition: sticking together well; forming a united whole
words.core_concept: what makes the pieces hold to one another – 使各块相互黏着的那份力
words.core_image: 湿沙攥成一团松手不散，干沙一松就漏下去
semantic_expansions: 有黏性的：能把彼此黏住的
团结的：一群人同样相互黏着不散
words.recall_hint: co-（一起）+ hes（黏住）+ -ive → 能相互黏住的

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ her（黏住）+ -ent → 黏在里头拿不掉的 → 固有的
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhaerens（附着于内的）← inhaerere ← in＋haerere（黏住）
words.native_definition: existing as a natural and permanent part of something
words.core_concept: stuck so deep inside that removing it would break the thing – 黏在里头，要取出来就得把那东西拆了
words.core_image: 花纹是烧进瓷胎里的，擦不掉也磨不去
examples: Risk is inherent in the job.
semantic_expansions: 固有的/内在的/天生的：黏在里头取不出来的那部分
words.recall_hint: in-（在内）+ her（黏住）→ 黏在里头拿不掉

words.root_logic: haes（卡住不动）+ -itate（反复）→ 反复卡在那儿 → 迟疑
words.origin: 拉丁语 haesitare（卡住、结巴）← haerere（黏住、卡住）的反复体
words.native_definition: to pause before doing something because of doubt
words.core_concept: the foot that lifts and comes back down in the same spot – 脚抬起来又落回原处，没往前挪
words.core_image: 他手伸到一半停住，收回来又伸出去
semantic_expansions: 犹豫/迟疑：脚抬起又落回原处，反复卡在那儿
words.recall_hint: haes（卡住）+ -itate（反复）→ 反复卡在那儿

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ fend（击）→ 把来的击开、使它离远 → 防御
words.origin: 古法语 defendre ← 拉丁语 defendere（挡开、保护）← de＋fendere（击）
words.native_definition: to protect from attack; to argue in support of
words.core_concept: the arm put up so the blow lands somewhere else – 手臂架上去，那一下就落到别处
words.core_image: 他抬臂一格，砸下来的那下偏到了肩外
examples: They defended the city for weeks.
semantic_expansions: 保卫/防御：把来的击开使其落到别处
辩护：同样是把冲自己来的话挡开
words.recall_hint: de-（离开）+ fend（击）→ 把来的击开

words.root_logic: defend（挡开）+ -ce → 挡这件事，及用来挡的那一套
words.origin: 古法语 defense ← 拉丁语 defensa ← defendere（挡开）← de＋fendere
words.native_definition: the act of protecting; something that protects
words.core_concept: whatever is put between you and the blow – 架在自己与那一下之间的东西
words.core_image: 土墙、壕沟、拒马一层层排在前头
examples: The country spends much on defence.
He spoke in his own defence.
semantic_expansions: 防御/防务：挡这件事及用来挡的那一套
辩护：法庭上替自己挡的那番话
words.recall_hint: defend（挡开）+ -ce → 挡这件事及所用之物

words.root_logic: defence 的截短 → 拦在四周挡人畜的那道栅
words.origin: 中古英语 fens，defence 的截短形 ← 拉丁语 defendere（挡开）
words.native_definition: a barrier of wood or wire around a piece of land
words.core_concept: the line of stakes that keeps what is outside outside – 一排桩子把外头的挡在外头
words.core_image: 一排木桩钉进土里，中间拉着铁丝，牛走到那儿就停
examples: They built a fence around the yard.
semantic_expansions: 篱笆/栅栏/围栏：拦在四周、把外头挡在外头的那道
words.recall_hint: defence 截短 → 拦在四周挡人畜的那道栅

words.root_logic: frons（额头）→ 朝前的那一面 → 前部、正面
words.origin: 古法语 front（额、正面）← 拉丁语 frons（额头）
words.native_definition: the side that faces forward; the most forward part
words.core_concept: the face that meets you first as you come up – 你走近时先碰到的那一面
words.core_image: 屋子朝街那一面开着窗，背面只有一道墙
examples: Sit at the front of the bus.
Troops moved up to the front.
semantic_expansions: 前面/正面：朝前、先碰到的那一面
前线：两军相对时朝前的那一面
words.recall_hint: frons（额头）→ 朝前的那一面

words.root_logic: front（正面）+ -ier → 一国朝外那条边 → 边境；引申为未开之域
words.origin: 古法语 frontiere（前沿）← front ← 拉丁语 frons（额头、正面）
words.native_definition: the border between two countries; the edge of what is known
words.core_concept: the outermost line a land turns toward the world – 一片地朝外顶着的那条最外的线
words.core_image: 界桩一路排到山脊，过了那道线就是别处
examples: They crossed the frontier at night.
It is a new frontier in medicine.
semantic_expansions: 边境/边疆：一国朝外顶着的那条最外线
前沿：知识或技术顶到的那条边
words.recall_hint: front（正面）+ -ier → 朝外顶着的那条边

words.root_logic: con-（相对）+ front（额面）→ 额头对额头 → 正面相对
words.origin: 法语 confronter ← 中世纪拉丁语 confrontare ← com＋frons（额头）
words.native_definition: to face someone or something difficult directly
words.core_concept: turning to put your forehead against the other's – 转过身把自己的额头对上对方的
words.core_image: 他没有绕开，转过身直接站到那人跟前
examples: She confronted him about the lie.
semantic_expansions: 面对/对抗：转身把额头对上对方，不绕开
使对质：把两方拉到面对面
words.recall_hint: con-（相对）+ front（额面）→ 额头对额头

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈进别人的地界 → 侵入
words.origin: 拉丁语 invadere（侵入）← in＋vadere（迈步而行）
words.native_definition: to enter a place by force; to crowd into somewhere
words.core_concept: the foot coming down inside a line it had no right to cross – 脚落在本不该越过的那条线里侧
words.core_image: 界桩还立在那儿，一队人已经踩进了桩子里边
examples: Tourists invade the town each July.
semantic_expansions: 侵略/侵入：迈进本不该进的地界
涌入：大批人同样跨进来占满
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈进别人地界

words.root_logic: invade（侵入）+ -sion → 侵入这件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 invasio ← invadere（侵入）← in＋vadere
words.native_definition: an act of entering by force; an unwelcome intrusion
words.core_concept: the whole of that crossing, once it has happened – 跨进来这件事整个算下来
words.core_image: 第二天清早，界内已经全是别处来的脚印
examples: It was an invasion of privacy.
semantic_expansions: 入侵/侵犯：迈进本不该进之处这件事
words.recall_hint: invade（侵入）+ -sion → 侵入这件事

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈出去脱身 → 躲开
words.origin: 拉丁语 evadere（逃出）← ex＋vadere（迈步而行）
words.native_definition: to escape or avoid something, often by cleverness
words.core_concept: stepping out through the gap before the hand closes – 手合上之前先迈出那道缝
words.core_image: 追到墙角却没人，只有一扇半开的小门
semantic_expansions: 逃避/回避：手合上之前先迈出那道缝
躲开：同一动作用在具体的追捕上
words.recall_hint: e-（出）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈出去脱身

words.root_logic: fabula（讲出来的话）← fari（说）→ 讲给人听的那种短故事
words.origin: 古法语 fable ← 拉丁语 fabula（谈话、故事）← fari（说）
words.native_definition: a short story with a moral, often about animals
words.core_concept: the tale that exists only in the telling – 只靠口说才存在的那个故事
words.core_image: 老人一开口讲那只狐狸，孩子们就不出声了
semantic_expansions: 寓言/传说：靠口说流传的那种短故事
虚构之事：因此指不实之说
words.recall_hint: fabula（讲出来的话）← fari（说）→ 口说的故事

words.root_logic: fabula（故事）+ -ous → 像故事里那样的 → 惊人的、极好的
words.origin: 拉丁语 fabulosus（传说中的）← fabula（故事）← fari（说）
words.native_definition: extremely good; so great as to seem made up
words.core_concept: the kind of thing you would only expect to hear in a tale – 只该在故事里听到的那种
words.core_image: 端上来那一桌，客人先说了句「这哪像真的」
semantic_expansions: 极好的/惊人的：好到像只该在故事里听到
传说中的：本义，出自故事的
words.recall_hint: fabula（故事）+ -ous → 像故事里那样的

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ fant（fari 的现在分词 fans 说）→ 还不会说话的那个 → 婴儿
words.origin: 古法语 enfant ← 拉丁语 infans（不会说话的）← in-（不）＋fari（说）的现在分词
words.native_definition: a very young child, especially one not yet walking
words.core_concept: the one who has everything to say and no words yet – 什么都想表达、却还没有话的那个
words.core_image: 他张着嘴使劲出声，但那些声音还拼不成词
examples: The infant slept through the night.
semantic_expansions: 婴儿/幼儿：还不会说话的那个
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ fant（说）→ 还不会说话的那个

words.root_logic: flos（花）→ 植株开出来的那一朵
words.origin: 古法语 flour ← 拉丁语 flos/floris（花）
words.native_definition: the coloured part of a plant that produces seeds
words.core_concept: the part a plant puts out when it has strength to spare – 植株攒足了劲才推出来的那一处
words.core_image: 枝上那处颜色一天天张开，花瓣一层压着一层
semantic_expansions: 花：植株开出来的那一朵
开花：推出那一朵这个动作
words.recall_hint: flos（花）→ 植株开出的那一朵

words.root_logic: flos（花、最好的部分）→ fleur de farine（面之精）→ 面粉
words.origin: 中古英语 flour（面之精），与 flower 同词分化 ← 拉丁语 flos（花、精华）
words.native_definition: powder made from ground wheat, used for baking
words.core_concept: the finest layer sifted out of the ground grain – 磨过的谷里筛出来的最细那一层
words.core_image: 粗的留在筛上，落下来的那层白得发亮
examples: She dusted the board with flour.
semantic_expansions: 面粉：磨过的谷里筛出的最细那一层，本义即「面之精」
words.recall_hint: flos（精华）→ fleur de farine（面之精）→ 面粉

words.root_logic: flor（花）+ -ish → 开到最盛 → 兴旺、茁壮
words.origin: 古法语 florir ← 通俗拉丁语 florire ← 拉丁语 florere（开花）← flos（花）
words.native_definition: to grow well; to be successful and thriving
words.core_concept: the moment a thing puts out everything it has – 一物把攒下的劲全推出来那一刻
words.core_image: 那株移过来第二年就窜高一截，枝上密密都是花
semantic_expansions: 茁壮成长/兴旺/繁荣：把攒下的劲全推出来、开到最盛
words.recall_hint: flor（花）+ -ish → 开到最盛

words.root_logic: heres（继承人）→ 依法接过家产的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 eir ← 拉丁语 heres（继承人）；英语拼写的 h 是后来照拉丁语补的，不发音
words.native_definition: a person legally entitled to inherit property or a title
words.core_concept: the one named to receive when the holder lets go – 持有者松手时，被指名接住的那个
words.core_image: 文书上写着那个名字，老人一走东西就归他
examples: The heir to the throne was crowned.
semantic_expansions: 继承人/嗣子：持有者松手时被指名接住的那个
words.recall_hint: heres（继承人）→ 依法接过家产的那个人

words.root_logic: herit（继承）+ -age → 一代代传下来的那一份
words.origin: 古法语 heritage ← heriter ← 晚期拉丁语 hereditare（继承）← heres
words.native_definition: traditions and buildings passed down from earlier generations
words.core_concept: what each generation hands on without being asked to – 每一代自然而然交下去的那一份
words.core_image: 老屋、老手艺、老规矩，都是上一辈没说什么就留下的
examples: Music is part of her heritage.
semantic_expansions: 遗产/文化遗产：一代代传下来的那一份
传统：其中无形的那部分
words.recall_hint: herit（继承）+ -age → 一代代传下来的那份

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ herit（继承）→ 接进自己名下 → 继承
words.origin: 古法语 enheriter ← 晚期拉丁语 inhereditare ← in＋heres（继承人）
words.native_definition: to receive property or a quality from someone before you
words.core_concept: the thing coming into your hands because it left another's – 因为别人松了手，它才落进你手里
words.core_image: 钥匙从那只手落进这只手，屋子从此归后者
semantic_expansions: 继承：因别人松手而落进自己手里
遗传：性状同样由上一代传下来
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ herit（继承）→ 接进自己名下

words.root_logic: jocus（戏言）→ 说出来逗人笑的那句
words.origin: 拉丁语 jocus（玩笑、戏言）
words.native_definition: something said or done to make people laugh
words.core_concept: the line said only for the laugh it gets – 只为博一声笑而说的那句
words.core_image: 他把最后半句一压低，满桌人先是静了一下才笑
semantic_expansions: 玩笑/笑话：只为博一声笑而说的那句
words.recall_hint: jocus（戏言）→ 说出来逗人笑的那句

words.root_logic: jocus（玩物）→ 古法语 jouel（小玩赏物）→ 宝石
words.origin: 古法语 jouel（小玩物、饰件）← 拉丁语 jocus（玩笑、玩物）
words.native_definition: a precious stone; something highly valued
words.core_concept: the small bright thing kept only to be looked at – 留着只为看的那一小件亮东西
words.core_image: 绒布上那一点在灯下转个角度就换一种光
semantic_expansions: 宝石/珠宝：留着只为看的那一小件亮东西
珍品：以此喻极可贵之物
words.recall_hint: jocus（玩物）→ jouel（小玩赏物）→ 宝石

words.root_logic: jewel（宝石）+ -ry（成套）→ 成套的饰件
words.origin: 古法语 juelerye ← jouel ← 拉丁语 jocus（玩物）
words.native_definition: rings, necklaces, and similar ornaments worn on the body
words.core_concept: the small bright things put on the body to be seen – 戴在身上、供人看的那些亮小件
words.core_image: 抽屉里一格一格摆着，戴出去时挑那么一两件
semantic_expansions: 珠宝/首饰：戴在身上供人看的那些亮小件
words.recall_hint: jewel（宝石）+ -ry（成套）→ 成套的饰件

words.root_logic: dran（做）→ drama（做出来的那一场）→ 戏剧
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 drama ← 希腊语 drama（一场演出）← dran（做、行动）
words.native_definition: a play for theatre or television; an exciting series of events
words.core_concept: the doing put on a raised floor so all can watch – 摆到台上、让所有人看着的那一番做
words.core_image: 幕布拉开，台上的事一件件当着众人做出来
examples: The trial was full of drama.
semantic_expansions: 戏剧/剧本：摆到台上做给人看的那一场
戏剧性事件：现实里像那一场一样起伏的事
words.recall_hint: dran（做）→ drama（做出来的那一场）

words.root_logic: drama（一场演出）+ -ic → 像台上那一场的 → 引人注目的、剧烈的
words.origin: 拉丁语 dramaticus ← 希腊语 dramatikos ← drama ← dran（做）
words.native_definition: sudden and noticeable; relating to plays
words.core_concept: of the kind that makes every head turn, as on a stage – 属于「一动就满座回头」那一类
words.core_image: 价钱一夜之间翻了一倍，第二天所有人都在说这事
semantic_expansions: 剧烈的/引人注目的：一动就满座回头那种
戏剧性的：属于台上那一场的
words.recall_hint: drama（一场演出）+ -ic → 像台上那一场

words.root_logic: drastikos（见效猛的）← dran（做）→ 下手重、来得急的
words.origin: 希腊语 drastikos（有力的、见效的）← dran（做、行动）
words.native_definition: extreme and sudden, often severe in effect
words.core_concept: the kind of doing that leaves no room for halfway – 那种做法不留半途，一下到底
words.core_image: 他没有慢慢调，直接把整套换掉了
semantic_expansions: 激烈的/极端的/彻底的：下手重、不留半途的那种做法
words.recall_hint: drastikos（见效猛）← dran（做）→ 下手重的

words.root_logic: factio（做法、做成的样式）← facere（做）→ 一时通行的做法与样式
words.origin: 古法语 fachon（式样）← 拉丁语 factio（做、样式）← facere（做）
words.native_definition: a popular style of clothing or behaviour; a way of doing something
words.core_concept: the way of making that everyone happens to follow this season – 这一季众人恰好都照着做的那个样式
words.core_image: 街上的裁法今年忽然都改成一个走向，去年那种没人做了
examples: Short coats are back in fashion.
He did it in his own fashion.
semantic_expansions: 时尚/流行式样：一时通行的那种做法与样式
方式：做一件事所取的那个做法
words.recall_hint: factio（做法、样式）← facere（做）→ 通行的样式

words.root_logic: fais（facere 做）+ -ible（可…的）→ 做得成的 → 可行的
words.origin: 古法语 faisable（可做的）← faire ← 拉丁语 facere（做）
words.native_definition: possible to do or achieve
words.core_concept: the plan that survives the question can this actually be done – 经得住「这真做得成吗」一问的那个方案
words.core_image: 把工序一步步排下来，发现每一步都真办得到
examples: It is not feasible in one week.
semantic_expansions: 可行的/行得通的：经得住「真做得成吗」一问的那种
words.recall_hint: fais（做）+ -ible（可…的）→ 做得成的

words.root_logic: facsimile（fac simile 做得一样）的截短 → 传过去的那份复本
words.origin: 英语 fax 是 facsimile 的截短；facsimile ← 拉丁语 fac simile（做成相像的）← facere（做）
words.native_definition: a copy of a document sent over a phone line
words.core_concept: the copy made to come out the same at the far end – 在远处那头做出来、要求一模一样的复本
words.core_image: 这头把纸吃进去，那头一张一模一样的吐出来
semantic_expansions: 传真/传真件：在远处做出来、要求一模一样的复本
words.recall_hint: facsimile（fac simile 做得一样）截短 → 传过去的复本

words.root_logic: debere（本该有却不在手上）← de＋habere（持有）→ 该给的、到期的
words.origin: 古法语 deu（debvoir 的过去分词）← 拉丁语 debere（欠）← de＋habere（持有）
words.native_definition: owed as a debt or obligation; expected at a certain time
words.core_concept: what is on the books to be handed over, and the day it falls – 账上写着该交出去的那份，及该交的那天
words.core_image: 本子上记着日子，翻到那一页就知道该给了
examples: The rent is due on Friday.
The train is due at six.
semantic_expansions: 应付的/到期的：账上该交出去的那份及其期限
预期的：按约该到的那个时候
words.recall_hint: debere（本该有却不在手）← de＋habere → 该给的

words.root_logic: due（该给的）+ -ty → 该做的那一份 → 职责；也指该缴的那笔税
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 duete ← deu（该给的）← 拉丁语 debere ← de＋habere（持有）
words.native_definition: something one is obliged to do; a tax on goods
words.core_concept: the share of work that is owed, not chosen – 分给你、非做不可的那一份，不是你挑的
words.core_image: 值班表上那格写着他的名字，轮到就得在那儿
examples: It is your duty to report it.
They paid duty on the import.
semantic_expansions: 职责/义务：分给你、非做不可的那一份
关税：进出货物该缴的那笔
words.recall_hint: due（该给的）+ -ty → 该做的那一份

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ devoir（该做之事）→ 把该做的当成自己的事去尽力 → 努力
words.origin: 中古英语 endeveren，由 en-＋古法语 deveir（本分）← 拉丁语 debere ← de＋habere
words.native_definition: to try hard to do something
words.core_concept: taking what is owed as one's own and pushing at it – 把该做的那份认作自己的，往上使劲
words.core_image: 他把那份本不属他的活也接了过来，一样往前推
examples: She endeavored to finish on time.
semantic_expansions: 努力/尽力/尝试：把该做的认作自己的、往上使劲
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ devoir（该做之事）→ 当作己事去尽力

words.root_logic: en-/in-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 先出一笔把后顾之忧买掉 → 投保
words.origin: 英语 insure 是 ensure 的分化形 ← 古法语 enseurer ← 拉丁语 securus（无忧）← se-＋cura（挂心）
words.native_definition: to arrange for money to be paid if loss or damage happens
words.core_concept: paying a little now so the big loss is not yours to carry – 先付一点，把那笔大损失从自己肩上挪走
words.core_image: 每月扣掉一小笔，出事那天赔的是另一方
examples: They insured the house against fire.
semantic_expansions: 投保/为…保险：先付一点，把大损失从自己肩上挪走
words.recall_hint: in-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 出钱买掉后顾之忧

words.root_logic: grev（gravis 重）→ 压在心上那份沉 → 悲痛
words.origin: 古法语 grief（苦难）← grever（压重）← 拉丁语 gravare ← gravis（重的）
words.native_definition: very great sadness, especially after a death
words.core_concept: the weight that settles on the chest and does not lift – 压在胸口、久久不散的那份沉
words.core_image: 他坐着没说话，肩往下垮着，像有东西压在上头
semantic_expansions: 悲痛/悲伤：压在胸口久久不散的那份沉
words.recall_hint: grev（重）→ 压在心上那份沉

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ ert（ars 技艺、本事）→ 没本事动起来 → 惰性
words.origin: 拉丁语 inertia（无能、懒惰）← iners（无技艺的）← in-（不）＋ars（技艺）
words.native_definition: a tendency to stay unchanged; resistance to being moved
words.core_concept: the state of a thing that will not start moving on its own – 一物自己不会动起来的那个状态
words.core_image: 推第一下最费劲，一旦动起来反倒不用那么使力
semantic_expansions: 惯性/惰性：一物自己不会动起来的那个状态
不作为：把这份不动用在人或机构上
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ ert（技艺、本事）→ 没本事动起来

words.root_logic: credere（信托）→ creantare（许诺、应承）→ 应允给出 → 授予
words.origin: 古法语 granter（应允）← creanter ← 通俗拉丁语 credentare ← 拉丁语 credere（信托）
words.native_definition: to agree to give or allow something formally
words.core_concept: handing over what was asked because you take the asker at their word – 信得过对方所求，就把那份给了
words.core_image: 他把申请翻了一遍，抬头说了句可以，笔一签就批了
semantic_expansions: 授予/准予：信得过所求便把那份给出
补助金：这样给出的那笔钱
words.recall_hint: credere（信托）→ creantare（应承）→ 应允给出

words.root_logic: fundere（倒出）→ futilis（一倒就漏的容器）→ 白费的
words.origin: 拉丁语 futilis（易漏的、无用的）← fundere（倒出、流泻）
words.native_definition: having no useful result; pointless
words.core_concept: the leaky jar you keep filling that never holds anything – 一只漏的罐，一直往里倒却始终装不住
words.core_image: 水一勺勺倒进去，底下同时往外淌，怎么倒都不满
semantic_expansions: 无用的/徒劳的：像一只漏的罐，倒进去也留不住
words.recall_hint: futilis（一倒就漏的容器）← fundere（倒出）

words.root_logic: grammar（学问、法术书）的苏格兰语变体 → 施在人身上的那层魅 → 魅力
words.origin: 苏格兰语 glamer，为 grammar（旧时兼指法术之学）的变体 ← 希腊语 grammatikē ← graphein（刻写）
words.native_definition: an attractive and exciting quality
words.core_concept: the sheen laid over a thing so the eye will not look past it – 覆在一物上、叫人目光挪不开的那层光
words.core_image: 灯一打上去，本来平常的那身衣裳忽然亮得扎眼
examples: The city has a certain glamor.
She was drawn by the glamor of fame.
semantic_expansions: 魅力/诱惑力/光彩：覆在一物上、叫人目光挪不开的那层
words.recall_hint: grammar（旧兼指法术之学）的变体 ← graphein（刻写）

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ cline（klinein 倾斜）→ 朝一边斜过去 → 倾向
words.origin: 拉丁语 inclinare（使倾斜）← in＋clinare ← 希腊语 klinein（倾斜）
words.native_definition: to lean or slope; to tend toward an opinion
words.core_concept: the surface tipped so things roll one way, not the other – 面一斜，东西就只往那一边滚
words.core_image: 板子一头垫高，珠子全滚到低的那边去了
examples: I incline to agree with you.
semantic_expansions: 倾斜/斜坡：面朝一边斜过去
倾向：心里同样偏向某一边
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ cline（倾斜）→ 朝一边斜过去

words.root_logic: di-（分开）+ vorce（vertere 转）→ 各自转开 → 离婚
words.origin: 古法语 divorce ← 拉丁语 divortium（分离）← divertere（转开）← dis＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: the legal ending of a marriage; a complete separation
words.core_concept: two who had faced each other turning away – 本来对着的两人各自转开身
words.core_image: 两人在桌两边签完字，起身朝相反方向走出门
examples: There is a divorce between theory and practice.
semantic_expansions: 离婚：本来对着的两人各自转开
分离：两者之间同样转开、不再相接
words.recall_hint: di-（分开）+ vorce（转）→ 各自转开
